system.title: System settings
system.description: Every system-wide setting in one place: jump to a topic page or edit the general values here.
system.hub.title: Settings pages
system.hub.export_settings: Letterhead, logo and company contact details for PDF and Excel.
system.hub.territories: Countries, provinces, districts and distributor territories.
system.hub.exchange_rates: Daily TCMB/ECB rates and manual overrides.
system.hub.legal_texts: KVKK, AI guideline and other legal texts.
system.hub.modules: Turn modules on or off and set their defaults.
system.hub.whatsapp: The single WhatsApp number and its session.
system.hub.notification_center: Notification channels, SMS fallback and templates.
system.hub.auth_settings: Sign-in methods, password and OTP rules.
system.load_failed: System settings could not be loaded.
system.read_only: View only — editing requires the settings write permission.
system.groups.general_hint: General behavior that affects every module.
system.groups.contracts_hint: Dealer contract expiry and the read-only period.
system.groups.forecast_hint: Thresholds of the algorithmic stock forecast.
system.groups.services_hint: Vehicle intake and service flow rules.
system.groups.smtp_hint: Outgoing mail server; left empty, the environment configuration is used.
system.groups.mobile_hint: Minimum app version and store links; older versions are asked to update.
system.keys.forecast_min_days_hint: Minimum movement history before the stock forecast proposes anything.
system.keys.contract_grace_days_hint: Time after a contract expires before read-only mode; 0 = no grace.
system.keys.photo_standard_enabled_hint: Require the standard photo set at vehicle intake.
system.keys.bulk_undo_window_hours_hint: How long a bulk operation stays undoable after it ran.
system.keys.smtp_password_hint: The stored password is never shown.
system.secret_hint: Leave empty to keep the stored password; type a new one to change it.
coordinates.title: Map position
coordinates.hint: Enter the coordinates or pick the position on the map to appear in the dealer finder.
coordinates.pick_hint: Tap the map to pick the position.
coordinates.errors.latitude: Latitude must be a number between -90 and 90.
coordinates.errors.longitude: Longitude must be a number between -180 and 180.
coordinates.errors.pair: Enter latitude and longitude together, or leave both empty.
system.hub.glorian: Glorian hub connection, sync runs and the drift report.
system.labor.title: Warranty claim labor rule
system.labor.description: Who carries the labor cost when a warranty claim is re-applied.
system.labor.rules.dealer_hint: Labor stays with the dealer; the center pays no labor.
system.labor.rules.center_hint: The center credits the labor amount to the dealer (through the distributor).
system.labor.rules.shared_hint: The center credits the given percentage of the labor amount.
system.labor.amount_hint: Per re-application, in the organization's currency.
system.labor.errors.amount_number: Enter a valid amount (up to 2 decimals).
system.labor.errors.percent_range: The percentage must be between 0 and 100.
system.keys.contracts_intake_required_hi: When on (and the intake contract module is enabled), a service cannot move to processing or be completed until its intake contract is signed.
system.groups.leads_hint: Lead pipeline and the public dealer application form.
system.keys.leads_dealer_application_ena: When on, the public application form at /bayi-basvuru is live and listed in the sitemap. It can only be switched on while the leads module is open system wide.
system.groups.mcp_hint: Limits of the MCP endpoints that AI clients (Claude, ChatGPT) connect to.
system.keys.mcp_requests_per_hour_per_or: MCP requests per organization per hour
Requests one organization may make per hour over all connected AI apps; further requests are refused until the window ends.
system.groups.whatsapp_hint: WhatsApp conversations, send rate and AI replies.
system.keys.whatsapp_ai_staff_pause_minu: AI pause after a staff message (minutes)
The AI does not answer a conversation a staff member wrote in within this time; 0 = no pause.
system.keys.whatsapp_ai_guidelines_url_h: Guidelines link (https) sent with the WhatsApp consent question; empty = the guidelines text is sent in the message.
